49f0376838eac61b9c60d1c90116894c1d99b549.sourceText: `sensor_scan` 是配准扫描转换回雷达系的结果，不会恢复已被 Point-LIO 丢弃的点，也不执行新的估计或运动补偿。位置与点坐标沿用 m，姿态为无量纲四元数，线速度字段按 m/s、角速度字段按 rad/s 表达；速度含义仍需结合下文的源码缺口判断。
49f0376838eac61b9c60d1c90116894c1d99b549.translatedText: `sensor_scan`This is the result of converting the registered scan back to the radar frame; it will not recover points that have already been discarded by Point-LIO, nor does it perform new estimation or motion compensation\. Positions and point coordinates continue to use m, orientations are dimensionless quaternions, the linear velocity field is expressed according to m/s, and the angular velocity field according to rad/s; the meaning of the velocities still needs to be determined in conjunction with the source code gap described below\.
